## What is this?

- [ ] Adding a new `community/<id>.json` entry
- [ ] Updating an existing `community/<id>.json` entry
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

## Checklist (community entries)

- [ ] `id` matches the `id` inside my plugin's own `plugin.json`
- [ ] `repo` is a public GitHub repository
- [ ] `manifestPath` resolves to a real `plugin.json` in that repo
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/build-index.mjs` locally and committed the
      regenerated `index.json`
